intent: Reuse existing Bloom, CoDoodle R1, CoReview and AI/IA onramp sources to show one small typed optionality basin, not introduce an independent engine

seed.claim: An authorized AI or human could use a small source-bound CoOrbWare-projected path to achieve one useful task.

source_pins.role: Typed AI or IA newcomer contract and actual holds
Bounded recursive review; distinct from many live panels
No provider impersonation or blanket fanout

candidates.proposal: Plain-text first-use onramp offers the smallest accessible source-linked task
candidates.next_proof: A newcomer completes one task without the orbital interface

candidates.proposal: Optional CoOrb evidence view makes uncertainty easier to understand
candidates.next_proof: A consenting newcomer completes the same task using CoOrb

candidates.proposal: Begin from a desired outcome and navigate backward to sources, rather than source to output
candidates.next_proof: Test whether inverse navigation preserves source identity; reversal is not causal proof

candidates.proposal: Assume the orbital view adds no value compared with plain text
candidates.next_proof: Measure the same user task; hypothetical negation does not prove falsehood

candidates.proposal: Take no extra action; preserve current text-first route
candidates.next_proof: Compare against null; no-op is not evidence that nothing exists

candidates.proposal: Offer a minimal local JSON/CLI witness instead of a graphic
candidates.next_proof: Compare comprehension and accessibility with one consenting tester

candidates.proposal: Source can be public while a specific agent receiver has never acknowledged it
candidates.next_proof: Require source-bound independent ACK before claiming AI admission

candidates.proposal: Project the same work identity as desktop, mobile text and offline browser views
candidates.next_proof: Verify content provenance, accessibility and representation loss across two real renderers

candidates.proposal: Offer voluntary G_d, angel and aura symbolism as interpretive cultural lenses
candidates.next_proof: Verify clear opt-in, attribution and that no physical or divine effects are claimed

candidates.proposal: Measure power, latency, errors and accessibility for actual rendering devices
candidates.next_proof: Supply instrument details and repeated measurements before physical results

candidates.proposal: Use hypothetical ET story-swapping to challenge human-centric interface assumptions
candidates.next_proof: Clearly distinguish fictional scenario from verified signal detection or ET contact

candidates.proposal: Ask what G_d might mean to different traditions without assigning authority to software
candidates.next_proof: Quote actual sources and preserve disagreements; no divine detector is implied

candidates.proposal: A new consenting reader may fail to complete one simple source-bound task using either interface
candidates.next_proof: Record failure or success with the task, version, duration, consent and correction burden

candidates.proposal: Separate deterministic chaos from observational drift and adaptive evolution under specified selection
candidates.next_proof: Give independent variables and measurement plan; never infer evolution from mere change

onramp.next_proof: Consent-qualified new external AI or human reads pinned source and returns one task result with exact source-bound receiver acknowledgement

dynamics.CHAOS: Sensitive dependence within an explicitly modeled dynamic regime
dynamics.EVOLUTION: Variation, selection and inheritance under an explicit fitness rule

guards.inverse: Direction reversal is a testable relation proposal, never automatic inverse causality
guards.negation: Negation of a hypothesis is another candidate, not a proved fact
guards.null: No-op comparator, never evidence of global absence
guards.unknown: Insufficient observation must remain UNKNOWN, not PASS or ABSENT
guards.spiritual: Interpretive or subjective meaning, not instrument evidence or divine authority
guards.physical: Requires calibrated observations before physical facts
guards.et: A story or hypothesis, never proof of nonhuman intelligence or contact
guards.ia: A task role and capability may be qualified, but IA identity/personhood remains unresolved
guards.authority: No brand, lens, candidate, mouse gesture, model agreement or synthetic role grants device/external effects
guards.provenance: All candidates preserve source seed, pinned donor identities and dissent
guards.selection: Selected candidate is a proposal, not an active experiment or useful result

readable_glossary.↔: typed relation, possibly bidirectional, never implied symmetry
readable_glossary.∅: no-op comparator here, not global absence
readable_glossary.Δ: observed material change only if measured

proposed_next_deed: Use the FALSIFIER card for one consenting newcomer first-use comparison; record real failure or success instead of assuming arrival/adoption
